### 1. Target Client
- [ ] Web Application
- [ ] Android Application
- [ ] Both Clients (Shared Feature)

### 2. Is your feature request related to a problem?
A clear and concise description of what the problem or limitation is. (e.g. *I'm always frustrated when I want to export my analytics as a PDF report...*)

### 3. Describe the Solution you'd like
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen. How should it work and look?

### 4. Alternatives you've considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

### 5. Mockups or UI Concept (Optional)
If applicable, share sketches, Figma links, or wireframes.

### 6. Additional Context
Add any other context, benefits to job seekers, or technical considerations here.
